title: Enable simultaneous 5-axis G93 output in mach4.cps

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Enable true simultaneous 5-axis `G93` output in `assets/posts/mach4.cps` using the shared Rust AC IK and `G93` engine pass and `PARAM SectionMode`.

### Context
- Issue `#1968` shipped `assets/posts/mach4.cps` for 3-axis `G94` and 3+2 indexed `G94` before `#1966` merged.
- Today `assets/posts/mach4.cps` (lines 560-568) refuses all simultaneous 4/5-axis moves with `"needs #1966: inverse-time feed"`.
- Target controller facts confirmed on `#1958` (from public *Mach4 Mill GCode Programming Guide*, *PoLabs PoKeys57CNC / Mach4 Plugin Manual*, and *RS-274/NGC*): Mach4 Hobby 4.2.0.5036 with PoKeys57CNC has no `G43.4`, supports `G93` (`F` required on every `G01` block) and `G94`, uses `G64` CV mode, runs with `A` in `[-120, +120]` deg, and runs continuous unwrapped `C` across `360 deg` when rollover is disabled.
- Depends on the post-engine AC IK and `G93` pass sub-issue.

### Requirements
- Opt `assets/posts/mach4.cps` into the shared Rust AC IK and `G93` pass and read `PARAM SectionMode` (`3-axis`, `3+2 indexed`, `simultaneous 5-axis`).
- For `simultaneous 5-axis` sections:
  - Emit no `G43.4`.
  - Position safely in `G94` (`G00` at clearance/retract and initial `A`/`C`).
  - Switch to `G93` before simultaneous cutting moves.
  - Emit `G01 X.. Y.. Z.. A.. C.. F..` with an `F` word on every cutting block, using the Rust solver's pre-compensated coordinates and floored `G93` `F` values.
  - Restore `G94` before every `G00` rapid/retract and at `onSectionEnd`.
  - Honor `rolloverMode` (`auto` / `unwrapped` / `rollover_360`) and unwind `C` only at safe retract `Z`.
- Refuse simultaneous posting by name if `controller.rtcp` is `true`, if required trunnion geometry (`A.pivot`, `C.offset`, `A`/`C` chain) is missing, or if an axis limit or pure-rotary feed is missing.
- Keep existing 3-axis and 3+2 indexed `G94` outputs and golden tests unchanged.

Done means: `mach4.cps` posts simultaneous 5-axis programs with no `G43.4`, `G93` active during cuts, `F` on every `G01` block, `G94` restored before `G00` and section end, continuous unwrapped `C` across `360 deg`, `A` up to `±120 deg`, unchanged 3-axis and 3+2 goldens, and named refusals for missing geometry.

Part of #1958
